data.comment: Second stage crayfish, similar to the adult crayfish except for the lack of the tail fan. Then they molt again after 3 weeks when they are 13-15 mm length, look like adults

data.label: ultimate total length for females
data.comment: Even though 15 cm listed as maximum size, it says that under favorable conditions, 90mm can be reached in 4 summers = probably 15cm is very rare

data.label: max reprod rate
data.comment: Number of attached eggs ranges from 80 -200, repro once per year, egg diameter 2.8 to 3.1 mm. At 90 mm total length, number of attached eggs can vary from 87 to 154 eggs
